items.headline: Winner takes all — the WNBA Finals come down to a Game 7 on Saturday
items.body: Atlanta refused to let the expansion Golden State Valkyries lift the trophy on their home floor, grinding out an 80-69 Game 6 win to drag this Finals the full distance. It's all square at 3-3, with everything on the line Saturday night back in the Bay (8 ET) — the two-year-old Valkyries chasing a fairytale first title against Angel Reese and a Dream team hunting the franchise's first championship too.
items.say: The WNBA Finals are going all the way to a Game 7 on Saturday — a two-year-old expansion team against Atlanta, winner takes the title. It's been such a fun underdog series. You catch any of the W this year?

items.headline: Rookie watch — Cam Boozer drops a triple-double early in his first NBA season
items.body: The Grizzlies' prized No. 3 pick (and son of two-time All-Star Carlos Boozer) stuffed the sheet for 18 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists in a 124-103 win over Portland. And he wasn't even the top rookie line of the night — Sacramento's Darius Acuff Jr. poured in 34 points with 14 assists. The 2026 draft class is announcing itself in a hurry.
items.say: Cam Boozer — Carlos Boozer's kid — just put up a triple-double as a rookie. This new NBA draft class is already putting on a show. You keeping up with the league this year?

items.headline: Heavyweight Sunday — Liverpool host Arsenal at Anfield
items.body: The pick of the Premier League weekend: Liverpool welcome Arsenal to Anfield on Sunday (11:30 a.m. ET on Peacock) in an early-season statement game between two of the title favorites. Few fixtures in English football carry more edge than these two — expect a loud, nervy afternoon on Merseyside.
items.say: Liverpool-Arsenal at Anfield on Sunday — probably the biggest Premier League game of the weekend. Those two really don't like each other. You follow the English stuff, or just the big ones?

items.headline: Counter-Strike's $1.25M Bucharest event hits the finish line — grand final Saturday
items.body: PGL Masters Bucharest is down to the business end: the single-elimination semifinals play out today in Romania, with the best-of-five grand final — and the lion's share of a $1.25M prize pool — set for Saturday. The sport's heavyweights (Vitality, NAVI, MOUZ, FURIA and more) have been scrapping all week to get there.
items.say: That big Counter-Strike tournament in Bucharest wraps up this weekend — grand final's Saturday, over a million bucks on the line. You play any CS, or watch the pro scene?

items.headline: Canelo is back — he returns Saturday against unbeaten Christian Mbilli
items.body: Boxing's biggest star, Saúl 'Canelo' Álvarez, climbs back through the ropes Saturday in Riyadh to face undefeated Christian Mbilli for the WBC super-middleweight title. It headlines a loaded 'Mexico vs. the World' card as part of Saudi Arabia's Riyadh Season — Canelo's first fight since last year's loss to Terence Crawford.
items.say: Canelo's fighting again Saturday — back in Saudi Arabia against an undefeated guy, Christian Mbilli. He's still the biggest name in the sport. You follow the fights at all?

items.headline: The King of the Monsters takes Manhattan — the 'Godzilla Minus Zero' trailer is here
items.body: The follow-up to the Oscar-winning 'Godzilla Minus One' just dropped a jaw-dropping new trailer, with returning director Takashi Yamazaki sending Godzilla stomping toward New York this time. It's the first Japanese movie shot for IMAX, and it hits US theaters November 6.
items.say: Did you see the new Godzilla trailer? It's the sequel to that incredible 'Minus One' movie — this time he's wrecking New York. Out in a couple of weeks. You a Godzilla guy?

items.headline: BigXthaPlug swings back to rap — new album 'Better Over Time' is out today
items.body: After a year-long detour into country, the Dallas heavyweight drops his fourth album today — the 18-track 'Better Over Time,' a return to the booming Texas rap that made his name. The guest list runs the gamut, from GloRilla and Lil Yachty to pop star Ava Max.
items.say: BigXthaPlug dropped a new album today — the big Dallas rapper who had that country moment. This one's back to straight-up rap. You heard any of his stuff?

items.headline: Bill Hader is the Cat — Warner Bros. drops its unhinged 'Cat in the Hat' trailer
items.body: The new animated take on the Dr. Seuss classic has a trailer out, with Bill Hader voicing a manic Cat and a cast stacked with comedy ringers — Quinta Brunson, Bowen Yang and Matt Berry among them. It's the first release from the relaunched Warner Bros. animation studio, in theaters November 6.
items.say: There's a new animated 'Cat in the Hat' with Bill Hader as the Cat — the trailer looks completely unhinged. Out in a couple of weeks. You have little kids, or just a Seuss fan?

items.headline: It's Halloween tomorrow — got the costume and candy sorted?
items.body: The big spooky night lands on a Saturday this year, so this is your last-call weekend for a costume and a bowl of candy by the door. And if you want a soundtrack that isn't 'Thriller' for the fiftieth time, Ray Parker Jr.'s 'Ghostbusters' is still an undefeated Halloween anthem more than 40 years on.
items.say: Halloween's tomorrow — you doing anything, costume or handing out candy? I'm mostly just here for the leftover candy, honestly.
